name: Chunk Deduplicator
description: Remove exact duplicates under a declared scope while preserving which document each appearance came from, and gate embedding reuse on a fingerprint that names the field that differs.
install: No dependencies. Copy with: ragkit add chunk-deduplicator
missing_dependency_message: chunk-deduplicator needs no package. If a vector is being reused that should not be, compare the stored fingerprint against the current configuration -- the gate names the field that differs rather than reporting a bare hash.
